reason: rest preserves an existing v3 tuple definition while changing its rest schema; _tuple constructs a v4 schema from a Class and item list. Inputs, definition format and version boundary differ.

init registers traits, invokes the initializer and binds prototype methods; the bundled initializer installs error issues. Their writes and responsibilities differ, and source must not depend on a generated bundle.
Enum parsing validates strings and membership, caches allowed values and can succeed; the BigInt helper unconditionally reports an invalid bigint and returns INVALID.

The v3 factory processes error parameters and creates a v3 typeName definition; the generated v4 bundle uses a different definition contract and omits those parameters. Sharing an intersection name is insufficient.
The map factory constructs key/value schema storage; default wraps an existing schema with a default-value thunk. The classes, stored fields and accepted arguments differ.
The promise factory wraps an inner schema as ZodPromise; transform builds ZodEffects around this with an executable callback. These are different schema operations, not duplicate factories.

_apply_parse builds a parsing chain and handles strict annotations and the field-type marker; _check_func installs a value predicate that can raise ValueError. Their validators implement different contracts.

get_callable_return_type unwraps callable objects, collects return hints and can return PydanticUndefined; eval_type converts and evaluates one annotation value. The latter does not perform the former's discovery.

get_function_type_hints collects an annotation dictionary with namespace, partial and type-parameter handling; try_eval_type evaluates a single value and returns a value/success tuple with NameError recovery.

The example scoring adapter calls estimator.predict and returns a dictionary for cross-validation. class_likelihood_ratios consumes two label arrays, computes confusion-matrix ratios, and returns a numeric tuple. Caller and callee are not interchangeable.
The first returns whether a template literal has expressions; checkExpression dispatches multiple AST kinds to formatting checks and returns void. It is an effectful visitor rather than a predicate.

The first tests const/readonly declaration context and excludes interpolated templates; getTemplateLiteral unwraps a type/value AST node and returns a literal node or null. Return shape and examined structure differ.
isDefinitionFile returns a case-normalized declaration-file predicate including arbitrary .d.*.ts names; getExtension returns a case-sensitive suffix or null. Their outputs and matching rules differ.

One checks imported external-module interface/type-alias merging using scope; the other applies the ignoreTypeValueShadow option and compares value/type variable categories. They answer different shadowing questions.

Spread checking reports disallowed string spreading; throw checking accepts configured any/unknown/Error-like types and reports invalid thrown values. Shared checker/report APIs do not make their validation policies duplicates.
isString returns a recursively computed StringLike predicate; getEnumValueType maps enum values to Number/String flags or undefined. Its output is a classification, not the same boolean predicate.

isClassInstance recursively distinguishes instances from constructor-like types; getConstructSignatureDeclaration returns a signature declaration for a symbol. Different input domains and return types prevent reuse as a replacement.

Class-declaration detection tests object flags and declaration kinds; isString tests StringLike flags. Their shared recursion driver is already reused, but these distinct leaf predicates must remain different.

specifierNameMatches compares TypeScript type symbol/intrinsic names against specifiers; isIdentifier checks an ESTree Identifier node and its spelling. The two compiler representations and resolution semantics differ.

populateProjectService normalizes options, validates globs and lazily initializes a cached service; validateDefaultProjectForFilesGlob only rejects broad patterns and returns void. This is orchestration versus an already-called validation step.

absolutify returns an absolute path using the project-service host directory; retrieveASTAndProgramFor retrieves script/program state and produces an AST/program pair or undefined. Reading the same service does not imply duplicate work.
The nested getCurrentDirectory returns a path string; createProgramFromConfigFile reads a config and constructs a compiler program and host. Path lookup is not program construction.

teardown conditionally removes INTEGRATION_TEST_DIR; setup creates fixture/tar/temp directories, packs packages, writes dependency configuration and installs fixtures. These are opposite lifecycle effects, not redundant implementations.
The AST/source ranges show ZodTuple contains ZodTuple._parse. Replacing the enclosing class with its parsing method destroys the class interface and is not independent duplicate code.
ZodNativeEnum is the enclosing class of ZodNativeEnum._parse, verified from the AST ranges and qualified names. Class construction and its own method are not alternative implementations.
_Definitions contains finalize_schema in the same source range. The class owns definition storage and other operations; its own finalization method cannot replace that class.
PydanticModelField encloses to_argument. A field metadata class and its argument-conversion method are not independent interchangeable definitions.
RoutePattern encloses check, verified by source ranges and qualified names. A validation method cannot replace the route-pattern class and its matching interface.
RoutePattern.match is contained by its proposed target RoutePattern. A method cannot be replaced by the class containing its own implementation.
formatDiagnostics is a nested closure inside getParsedConfigFile; containing source and a captured-state formatting callback are not independent alternatives.
openClientFileAndMaybeReload is nested inside openClientFileFromProjectService. It uses captured project state for one stage of the containing orchestration; it cannot replace the enclosing function.

The changed v4 datetime accepts hours-only offsets using ([+-]\d{2}(?::?\d{2})?), whereas v3 datetimeRegex requires minutes. They also call different time/date sources. Their normalized structure is identical but substituting the old regex would undo the commit's fix.

The full v4 formatter creates and returns fieldErrors and maps new union/key/element issue layouts; the v3 nested processError returns void, requires captured mapper/fieldErrors, and reads unionErrors/returnTypeError/argumentsError. Shared traversal is not the same callable contract.
